summary: Learn to draft and manage climate resilience clauses, KPIs, insurance links, and claims for infrastructure and PPP contracts. Enrol today.
lede: Climate adaptation contract training helps infrastructure and PPP professionals turn climate risks into clear, manageable obligations. Participants practice screening hazards, allocating lifecycle risks, drafting measurable resilience clauses and KPIs, and linking contract duties with insurance and claims processes. It is designed for practitioners involved in drafting, negotiating, financing, administering, or enforcing infrastructure agreements.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who draft, negotiate, approve, finance, administer, or enforce climate adaptation contracts across infrastructure delivery and public-private projects. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with procurement, construction, utilities, project finance, engineering, or contract administration and need to connect climate risk with enforceable commercial terms.
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to contract management, procurement, infrastructure delivery, project finance, engineering administration, or public-private partnerships. Prior knowledge of FIDIC, NEC4, ISO 31000, or climate-risk assessment is useful but not required. No coding or programming is required. Advanced climate modelling, catastrophe modelling, and insurance underwriting receive conceptual or operational treatment rather than technical engineering instruction. Bring a laptop if you want to adapt the digital registers and KPI templates during practical exercises.
